# PNY Unveils NVIDIA GeForce RTX™ 5060 Family of Graphics Cards - NVIDIA’s Game Changing Blackwell Architecture Comes to Core Gamers Everywhere 

Parsippany, New Jersey, April 15, 2025 - Parsippany, New Jersey, April 15, 2025 - PNY announced today the arrival of the GeForce RTX™ 5060 Ti (16GB and 8GB), and RTX 5060 graphics cards to its lineup of NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50 Series GPUs.

...

## Supercharged Performance and Speed

The PNY GeForce RTX 5060 Family of graphics cards will be available three different variants: GeForce RTX 5060 Ti (with 16GB or 8GB) and RTX 5060, all powered by the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture, providing enhanced gaming realism, powerful real time ray tracing, and cutting-edge features to accelerate gaming performance. Factory-overclocked SKUs are available to maximize out-of-box performance on Blackwell architecture.

...

## Overclocking and ARGB Customization

The PNY GeForce RTX 5060 Family graphics cards feature one model per series with EPIC-X RGB lighting. With infinite ARGB lighting options, users can enjoy a fully customized lighting experience. Showcase creativity and personalize your lighting display using PNY's VelocityX™ control software, which also allows monitoring of key statistics such as core clock, memory clock, core temperature, fan speed, RGB lighting, and more.

## Build Small. Play Big.

The PNY GeForce RTX 5060 Family graphics cards offer a variety of form factors to fit the needs of core gamers across different PC setups. The RTX 5060 Ti models are offered in both dual-slot Triple Fan and Dual Fan form factors and the RTX 5060 models add a Single Fan model as well.

## Availability.

The PNY GeForce RTX 5060 Ti will be available starting Wednesday, April 16. The GeForce RTX 5060 version will be available in May.
